quarterly_data.signal: Modine furnished fiscal 2026 segment results recast for its new structure (Climate Solutions split into Data Centers and Commercial HVAC effective April 1, 2026). Recast Data Centers net sales were $183.7 million (three months ended June 30, 2025), $225.0 million (September 30, 2025), $297.6 million (December 31, 2025) and $401.9 million (March 31, 2026), for $1,108.2 million in the twelve months ended March 31, 2026; Data Centers operating income was $194.5 million and adjusted EBITDA $214.7 million (19.4% margin) for the twelve months.
